findings.concern: Dune target ownership could be misread as linkage
findings.resolution: every output scope and Rust dependency record explicitly denies ABI/symbol linkage; no graph or schema writer exists.

findings.concern: missing Dune fields could crash or create a default association
findings.resolution: optional fields become empty values and malformed Dune files yield no target; candidates are explicitly UNATTRIBUTED.

findings.concern: C source basename could overclaim an OCaml primitive mapping
findings.resolution: foreign_stub_source is emitted only for a C candidate named in foreign_stubs; OCaml externals retain same_dune_directory only.

accepted_limits: Dune parsing is a narrow direct-field subset.
Build declarations do not establish ABI or exact linked objects.
